errors.evidence: The description states that the horizontal axis contains two categories, "Accuracy (%)" and "Token Count". This is incorrect. The horizontal axis shows the four methods (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT) as categories, which are repeated for the two metrics shown as titles for each group of bars. The metrics are the grouping variables, not the categories on the axis.
The description claims that the bars have no outlines ("контури"), but all bars in the figure clearly have black outlines.

This phrase translates to "identically colored bars". The bars in the "Token-Count-Gruppe" are not identically colored; they are individually colored red, orange, light blue, and green according to the legend, using the same color scheme as the first group. The description incorrectly states that the bars are all the same color.

The description uses the word "etwa" (approximately) before a numerical value that is explicitly and precisely labeled on the chart. This adds unnecessary hedging and is repeated for all eight data points.
